claim: Compare elapsed time for one fresh skills list JSON request on a 32-skill workspace.
configuration: Offline source-entry image, isolated home and state per run, synthetic skills, bundled skills off, one CLI process per sample.

workload.input: Thirty-two fixed local fixtures, one main-agent list command, all rows verified in sorted order.
workload.plausibility: The timed region starts a Node CLI process and awaits it. A full startup and fixture read in under one millisecond indicates broken timing at this scale.
